name: LM358 dual-channel voltage follower (both halves as unity-gain buffers)
description: LM358 dual op-amp wired as two independent voltage followers: channel A buffers VIN_A → VOUT_A, channel B buffers VIN_B → VOUT_B. Single-supply power via V+ / GND. Exercises a *different* IC subtype than UA741 with the same PortType vocabulary, giving the model IC-heterogeneity training experience beyond what test_opamp_inverting_v1 (UA741 again) covers. Picked because LM358 has no NC pin (all 8 used) — different connection-policy footprint than UA741's pin 8 = FORBIDDEN.
